```bash
ps -p 855369 -o pid,etime,stat,cmd --no-headers 2>/dev/null || echo "DEAD"

nvidia-smi --query-gpu=index,utilization.gpu,memory.used,memory.total,temperature.gpu --format=csv,noheader

# 主日志

ls /root/autodl-tmp/checkpoints/exp029/ 2>/dev/null

grep -E "val_before_train|val-core|validation" ~/runs/cost-verify-agent-rl/exp029_episode_level.log 2>/dev/null | tail -10

grep -rE "val-core|success" /root/cost-verify-agent-rl/RAGEN/wandb/latest-run/logs/ 2>/dev/null | tail -10

grep -E "wandb.*run|Run.*url|https://wandb" ~/runs/cost-verify-agent-rl/exp029_episode_level.log 2>/dev/null | head -5

```

**6. 检查有无 OOM 或异常**
```bash
grep -iE "OOM|out of memory|CUDA error|RuntimeError|Traceback|killed" ~/runs/cost-verify-agent-rl/exp029_episode_level.log 2>/dev/null | tail -10
dmesg | grep -i "oom\|killed" | tail -5 2>/dev/null
```

```python
import wandb
api = wandb.Api()
# 查最新的 run

- 当前 step

- W&B run id
- 有无异常
